label: Late in the episode, rises at D1 after unrewarded trials (most after S2) and at D2 on S1.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * ((prev_state == S2) - in_rew) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 0) * ep_trial
terms: (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 0) * (prev_state == S2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 0) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * (prev_state == S1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * (action == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (in_rew == 0) * ep_trial
explanation: This candidate unit sits near -1 (saturated) and drifts upward strongly over the episode; timing explains R^2 0.70. Beyond timing, its history effects grow with episode trial: the effects are near zero early on and large in the last decades, and scaling terms by ep_trial lifted dev R^2 from 0.21 to 0.33. At D1 it rises after an unrewarded previous trial, most after an unrewarded S2 visit (a1 S2 u, a2 S2 u), and drops after a rewarded S1 visit. At D2 it is higher when the reached state is S1, more so after a rare a2->S1 transition. The free fit adds a small GO term graded by observer belief (higher when S1 is believed good) and the rare-transition D2 interaction. Belief, the trial before and the hidden good state add little. All terms are observed-only.
